text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release v2.14.3 -> canary (10%) as of 2026-03-22T15:00Z. Observability: slo-watch, latency-sentinel, route-sampling=10%. Notify if p95 or 5xx thresholds exceeded.

maria_ops: seeing a p95 jump for embeds-route on the canary shard — ~280ms right after shift :thinking:

sam_sre: confirming on dashboards, spike aligns with canary traffic at ~6141591650. baseline p95 ~120ms, current ~280ms. no big 5xx surge yet.

ken_release: @deploy-bot please pause rollout /deploy pause canary — want to freeze at 10% while we investigate

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by ken_release. Traffic frozen at 10%. Reason: slo_break p95 > 200ms for route embeddings-route.

maria_ops: quick call — do we pin to v2.14.2 for embeddings-route, or rollback the canary entirely?

laura_pm: FYI the change was a quantization kernel tweak. We saw perf improvement locally but maybe kernel selection favors different paths in eu-west.

travis_engineer: I can push a kernel-selection patch but need ~20m to validate. Given customer-facing SLOs, recommend rollback to v2.14.2 for canary to restore latency ASAP.

sam_sre: +1. will coordinate rollback. if anyone objects speak now.

sam_sre: /deploy rollback --to v2.14.2 --scope canary  # initiating

deploy-bot: Rollback command acknowledged. Starting rollback to v2.14.2 on canary. ETA ~4m. Will route canary traffic back to pinned version.

maria_ops: monitoring p95 and 5xx. escalation criteria: 5xx > 0.1% OR p95 > 180ms for 2 consecutive windows. adding a short suppression for noisy alerts.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. canary traffic now on v2.14.2 (10%). Health snapshot: p95=115ms, p50=30ms, 5xx=0.02% :white_check_mark:

ken_release: :thumbsup: Good catch everyone. We'll hold the staged rollout for 30m observation before resuming.

laura_pm: please add a line to the release notes: "Canary for v2.14.3 reverted due to latency regression on embeddings route; investigating kernel selection behavior."

sam_sre: added temporary alert suppression and a follow-up watch. will reopen if regression persists after rollback.

travis_engineer: I'll start reproducing the regression in a test cluster and prepare a kernel-select fix. ETA ~25m.

maria_ops: thanks — will keep this thread updated. if we see any downstream degradations i'll ping on-call L2.
